tolerance.note: pass if |got-expected| <= max(abs, rel*|expected|); per-case 'tol' overrides; strings, booleans, nulls, regimes and error classes exact

convention: SI units; angles in radians, theta0 in [-pi, pi]. |theta0|>pi -> ConstraintViolation, reason theta0_out_of_range (no wrapping; |theta0|=pi is in range). Undamped point-mass pendulum: theta'=omega, omega'=-(g/L) sin(theta); g is a positive downward magnitude; default g=9.81. Energy is specific mechanical energy E=L^2 omega^2/2+gL(1-cos theta) in J/kg. T0=2 pi sqrt(L/g). Exact period for release from rest: T=4 sqrt(L/g) K(k) with MODULUS k=sin(|theta0|/2) (scipy.special.ellipk takes m=k^2). Regimes are results (ruling 16:44): 'oscillatory' for 0<|theta0|<pi; 'at_rest' for theta0=0 (period reported as the small-angle limit T0, ratio 1); 'unstable_equilibrium' for |theta0|=pi with period_s and period_ratio null (never Infinity). Schemes: explicit Euler (theta,omega)+=dt f(theta,omega); classical 4-stage RK4; both on the state (theta, omega), fixed dt, exactly 'steps' steps from the given state. Errors (ruling 17:46: schema classes only, cause in expected.reason): MathError for g=0 (gravity_zero) and dt=0 (dt_must_be_positive); ConstraintViolation for L<=0 (length_must_be_positive), g<0 (gravity_must_be_positive), dt<0, |theta0|>pi (theta0_out_of_range); validation order L, g, dt, theta0. Per-case 'tol' overrides the file tolerance for scheme runs.
oracle: hand formulas re-checked independently in _build_fit_printers_tier1_kats.py: mpmath quadrature (30 digits) of the period integral cross-checked against scipy ellipk, solve_ivp of the linearised ODE for T0, own pure-Python Euler and RK4; multi-step expected values from a separate 40-digit mpmath implementation of the same schemes

cases.desc: Small-angle period, L=1 m
cases.hand_check: T0=2 pi sqrt(L/g)=2.0060667 s. Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems, small oscillations. Oracle: solve_ivp of the linearised ODE, half period from the first omega=0 event.

cases.desc: Small-angle period, L=2 m
cases.hand_check: T0=2 pi sqrt(2/9.81)=2.8370067 s. Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: solve_ivp of the linearised ODE.

cases.desc: Exact period at 30 degrees
cases.hand_check: T=4 sqrt(L/g) K(k), k=sin(theta0/2)=sin 15 deg (modulus; scipy ellipk takes m=k^2); T/T0=2K/pi=1.0174088. Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems; Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions, complete elliptic integral of the first kind. Oracle: mpmath quad of the period integral, cross-checked with scipy ellipk.

cases.desc: Required exact period at 90 degrees: T/T0=1.18034
cases.hand_check: k=sin 45 deg; T/T0=2K(k)/pi=1.1803406 (must-reproduce); T=2.3678419 s. Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions; Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: mpmath quad + ellipk.

cases.desc: Exact period at 120 degrees
cases.hand_check: k=sin 60 deg; T/T0=1.3728805; T=2.7540898 s. Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions. Oracle: mpmath quad + ellipk.

cases.desc: Near-separatrix exact period at 179 degrees
cases.hand_check: k=sin 89.5 deg, K~ln(4/k')=6.128 with k'=cos 89.5 deg; T/T0=3.9010652; T=7.8257968 s. Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions; Strogatz, Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos, separatrix. Oracle: mpmath quad (tanh-sinh handles the near-singular integrand) + ellipk.

cases.desc: Euler step from rest at theta=0 stays at rest
cases.hand_check: f(0,0)=(0,-g sin 0)=(0,0): both increments vanish. Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I, explicit Euler. Oracle: own float Euler.

cases.desc: RK4 step from rest at theta=0 stays at rest
cases.hand_check: All four RK4 stages are (0,0). Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I, classical RK4. Oracle: own float RK4.

cases.desc: Inverted equilibrium at 180 degrees: no finite period (result, not error)
cases.hand_check: k=sin(pi/2)=1, K(1) diverges: the inverted pendulum at rest is a physically valid (unstable) equilibrium, so per ruling 16:44 it is a regime result with period null (never Infinity in JSON). Strogatz, Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos, pendulum phase portrait; Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions. Oracle: |theta0|=pi test; mpmath confirms K(m) grows without bound as m->1.

cases.desc: Explicit Euler step increases energy
cases.hand_check: theta1=0.1+0.1(0)=0.1; omega1=-0.1(9.81)sin 0.1=-0.0979366; E=L^2 omega^2/2+gL(1-cos theta): E0=0.0490091, E1=0.0538049>E0. Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I. Oracle: own float Euler.

cases.desc: RK4 step: energy error about 6.3e-7 J/kg
cases.hand_check: Four RK4 stages give (0.0951430, -0.0963430); E1-E0=-6.318e-7 J/kg, about 7600 times smaller in magnitude than Euler's +4.8e-3 for the same step (RK4 is not exactly energy-conserving). Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I. Oracle: own float RK4; energy_change checked with tol abs 1e-15.

cases.desc: Euler step at a quarter-turn
cases.hand_check: sin(pi/2)=1: omega1=-0.981 rad/s; theta1=pi/2. Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I. Oracle: own float Euler.

cases.desc: Zero pendulum length is physically invalid
cases.hand_check: L>0 required; T0=0 would be computable but the model g sin(theta)/L is singular -> ConstraintViolation, reason length_must_be_positive (L is validated before g). Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: validation.

cases.desc: Negative pendulum length is physically invalid
cases.hand_check: L<0 is not a length (range is checked before the sqrt of a negative -> ConstraintViolation, reason length_must_be_positive). Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: validation.

cases.desc: Zero gravity: period divides by zero
cases.hand_check: T=4 sqrt(L/g)K(k) divides by g=0 -> MathError, reason gravity_zero (rulings 16:44, 17:46). CORRECTED from the draft's PhysicalParameterError. Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: zero-denominator test.

cases.desc: Negative gravity is physically invalid
cases.hand_check: g is a positive downward magnitude; g<0 is outside the model (ConstraintViolation, reason gravity_must_be_positive, same as mae_mechanics). Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: validation.

cases.desc: Zero time step is rejected
cases.hand_check: dt=0 -> MathError, reason dt_must_be_positive (FIT Site ruling 17:46; CHANGED from the draft's PhysicalParameterError). Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I. Oracle: validation.

cases.desc: theta0=0: pendulum at rest, small-amplitude period limit
cases.hand_check: k=0, K(0)=pi/2 so T=4 sqrt(L/g)(pi/2)=T0 (limit of the exact formula); no motion occurs, regime 'at_rest' (ruling 17:46). Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions; Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: mpmath quad at k=0.

cases.desc: Exact period is symmetric in the release angle (theta0=-90 degrees)
cases.hand_check: k=sin(|theta0|/2): same as x6-004. Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: mpmath quad + ellipk.

cases.desc: RK4 over one exact period at 90 degrees returns to the release state
cases.hand_check: dt=T_exact/2000 with T_exact=2.367841947576237 s (x6-004). Exact solution is periodic, so theta(T)=pi/2, omega(T)=0; RK4 global error O(dt^4) is ~4e-14 rad here (40-digit reference). Tolerance abs 1e-9. Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I; Abramowitz and Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions. Oracle: own float RK4 run.

cases.desc: Euler over the same exact period drifts and gains about 1.84% energy
cases.hand_check: Explicit Euler is not energy-stable for oscillators: energy rises every step, ending at E/E0=1.0184195 with theta=1.5890933 rad (0.0183 rad past the release angle) and omega=+0.0492 rad/s after one exact period, versus RK4's ~4e-14 in x6-020. Values from a 40-digit mpmath run of the same scheme with the same float dt; tol rel 1e-8. Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I, stability of explicit Euler. Oracle: own float Euler run.

cases.desc: Euler vs RK4 over 100 steps from 0.5 rad (dt=0.01 s)
cases.hand_check: Same initial state and step: Euler gains 9.87% energy in 1 s, RK4 changes energy by -1.2e-9 relative. Reference values from a 40-digit mpmath implementation of each scheme. Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I. Oracle: own float Euler and RK4 (pure Python).

cases.desc: Release angle beyond 180 degrees is rejected (no wrapping)
cases.hand_check: |theta0|=3.3 rad (189.08 deg) > pi: outside the allowed range [-pi, pi], checked before computing; no wrapping (FIT Site ruling 17:46). Marion and Thornton, Classical Dynamics of Particles and Systems. Oracle: range check.

cases.desc: Release angle exactly -180 degrees is in range: unstable equilibrium
cases.hand_check: |theta0|=pi is the inclusive range boundary, so it is a regime result (period null), not theta0_out_of_range. Strogatz, Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos. Oracle: range check + |theta0|=pi test.

cases.desc: RK4 run with release angle beyond 180 degrees is rejected
cases.hand_check: |theta0|=3.5 rad > pi -> ConstraintViolation, reason theta0_out_of_range (no wrapping, ruling 17:46). Hairer, Norsett and Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations I. Oracle: range check.
